acts.synopsis: Keeper-in-training Nia, late with her wind soundings, lets the Hollow's hill-road lantern fail on her watch through haste, not malice. The dark lantern and her grandmother's withheld trust become the engine of every later act.
acts.title: The Failure

acts.synopsis: Grandmother Yara sets the price: carry one keeper flame to the high cairn before the pass closes, and take the stranded ferryman's children waiting at the gorge station as Nia's charge. Nia resists, then accepts.
acts.title: The Debt

acts.synopsis: Valley crossing with Tam, the young ferryman, and his injured sister Lumi. Washed-out bridge, rope traverse, rockfall. At the midpoint the children save Nia first, inverting the debt.
acts.title: The Gorge

acts.synopsis: Storm ascent with one flame and two needs: Lumi's fever needs the flame's warmth now, the cairn needs it intact at the top. Nia spends half the flame, and the wind turns guide only after she pays a real price.
acts.title: The Choice

acts.synopsis: The stub should not be enough, but the valley answers: every household that kept a spark through the dark raises it as she passes, and the cairn lights from many flames, Nia's least among them. Yara hands Nia the keeper's knot without a word.
acts.title: Hearthlight

shots.board: Wide valley vista at dusk. Rows of small lantern dots along the hollow; the near hill-road lantern burns low, unattended. Nia's hill silhouette at frame right, head bent over her sounding ribbons instead of the wick. Slow push in.

captions.line: Ember Hollow kept one lantern for the whole hill road, and Nia kept that lantern.
Just one more sounding. The lantern can wait one sounding.

continuity.cause: Opening image: establishes the lantern, the ribbons, and Nia's divided attention, the fault the whole film answers for.
continuity.entry: Nia on the hill road at dusk with sounding ribbons and a lit but untended hill lantern; flame full.
continuity.exit: Hill lantern burning low, still lit; Nia absorbed in her ribbons; flame faltering.

music.mood: hushed strings, low wind pad under a small neglect

shots.title: The untended lantern

shots.board: Nia on the hilltop, cloak lifting in gusts. A cross-gust takes the low flame sideways off the wick; the lantern goes dark against the wind. She grabs too late. Medium shot, gentle pan following the smoke.

captions.line: The gust took the flame the way a wave takes a footprint.
No. No, come back. I was here. I was right here.

continuity.cause: Follows s01: the untended low flame meets the cross-gust the ribbons had been warning about all evening.
continuity.entry: Hill lantern low but lit; Nia distracted by ribbons; flame faltering.
continuity.exit: Hill lantern dark and smoking; Nia alone with the dead lantern; flame dark.

music.mood: solo woodwind over soft strings, the theme stumbling

shots.title: The hillside extinguishing

shots.board: Close on Nia's charcoal wind-chart beside the dead lantern: swirling arrows that all bent away from the hill road, warnings she never read. Her blackened hand tries a spark-striker, fails, tries again. Match-cut framing to her eyes.

captions.line: Light. Light, you stupid wick.
Her charts could map every wind in the valley, and none of them could carry a spark.

continuity.cause: Follows s02: Nia carries the dead lantern to her chart table and tries to undo the failure alone before facing Yara.
continuity.entry: Dead lantern and unread chart on the table; Nia desperate; flame dark.
continuity.exit: Striker sparks will not catch; Nia out of solitary fixes; flame dark.

music.mood: nia theme fragments, unresolved and self-reproaching

shots.title: Sparks that will not catch

shots.board: Night falls fast. Two more lanterns gutter out along the hollow road in a visual beat, one, then another. Nia runs downhill toward grandmother's house with the dead lantern clutched to her chest, lantern-light shrinking behind her.

captions.line: Grandma Yara! The hill lantern is out, and it was my watch, it was my fault!
She ran downhill with the dead lantern, and the dark ran with her.

continuity.cause: Follows s03: solitary repair failed, so Nia runs to the one person who can rekindle a keeper lantern.
continuity.entry: Nia leaving the chart table with the dead lantern; flame dark.
continuity.exit: Nia arriving at Yara's door; the hollow road darker behind her; flame dark.

music.mood: low brass swell under strings, the dark spreading

shots.title: Down to Yara

shots.board: Inside Yara's lamplit house: walls of charts, a cold hearth, the old keeper listening without moving. Nia sets the dead lantern down between them like an accusation against herself.

captions.line: So. The valley asks at last what it has been owed.
You will carry one keeper flame to the high cairn. And you will take the ferryman's children waiting at the gorge station.
The pass is closing! I can barely carry myself!

continuity.cause: Follows s04: Nia's confession arrives at Yara's door, and Yara answers a fault with a price, not a pardon.
continuity.entry: Nia with the dead lantern before Yara; Yara still; no keeper flame committed; flame dark.
continuity.exit: Price set: one flame, one cairn, two children as Nia's charge; keeper flame kindled but not yet given; flame kindled.

music.mood: warm low strings, cradle rhythm under a hard bargain

shots.title: What the valley is owed

shots.board: Close on Yara's large steady hands kindling the keeper's lantern from the hearth coal, then holding it out. Nia's small hands hover, pull back, then close around the handle. The flame leans but holds.

captions.line: This flame has burned through four keepers. It does not burn for the swift, little wind-reader. It burns for the steady.
What if I drop it? What if I am not—
I will be steady.

continuity.cause: Follows s05: Nia's protest collapses into acceptance, so Yara entrusts the kindled flame into her hands.
continuity.entry: Keeper flame kindled on the hearth; Nia protesting; flame kindled.
continuity.exit: Keeper lantern lit in Nia's hands; Yara's trust given conditionally; flame guarded.

music.mood: nia theme and cairn hymn intertwined, hands over fear

shots.title: The keeper's lantern

shots.board: The forbidden chart unrolled: the gorge, the washed-out bridge marked in Yara's mother's hand, the cliff path, and the station circle where two small figures wait. Yara's finger traces the path Nia must walk with children in tow.

captions.line: The bridge washed out in my mother's time. A ferryman's boy waits at the station with his sister, and the girl is hurt.
Then draw me the cliff path. Every step.

continuity.cause: Follows s06: with the flame in her hands, Nia must learn the charge that comes with it: two children on a broken path.
continuity.entry: Lantern lit in Nia's hands; the station children still only marks on a chart; flame guarded.
continuity.exit: Cliff path memorized; Nia knows Tam and Lumi by name and need; flame guarded.

music.mood: solo cello line, sparse, the old ink speaking

shots.title: Two marks on the chart

shots.board: Threshold farewell at first light. Yara knots the storm-ribbon into Nia's scarf, slowly, the whole goodbye played in the hands. Nia steps out with lantern, pole, and chart; the door light stays lit behind her.

captions.line: If the wind takes your map, follow the moss. If it takes your courage, follow the light. Come back a keeper, Nia.
Hold the door light for me. Just till the gorge.

continuity.cause: Follows s07: the path learned and the flame held, so the errand begins with Yara's knotted ribbon and an open door.
continuity.entry: Nia equipped but untested at the threshold; Yara's door light lit; flame guarded.
continuity.exit: Nia on the road with lantern, ribbon, and charge; Yara waiting; flame guarded.

music.mood: full string swell, first brass hint at the door light

shots.title: Threshold farewell

shots.board: The low valley under a pushing sky. At the shepherd's hut Nia leaves half her bread and a lit spill from her own tinderbox, kindling the old woman's cold hearth. Small kindness, played wide: the hut window warms as she walks on.

captions.line: The low valley did not want her there. At the shepherd's hut she left half her bread and a lit spill, and walked on lighter.
Mind the north gully, shepherd! The wind is turning there!

continuity.cause: Follows s08: the errand begins, and Nia's first free choice on the road is generosity, the act the finale will answer.
continuity.entry: Nia on the road with full pack and guarded flame; shepherd's hearth cold; flame guarded.
continuity.exit: Shepherd's hearth lit from Nia's tinderbox; keeper flame untouched; first spark kept in the valley; flame guarded.

music.mood: wind motif aggressive, strings short-bowed against her

shots.title: The shepherd's hearth

shots.board: The gorge station: a beached ferry-boat, a boy with an oar he cannot use on cliffs, and a small girl with a bound ankle sitting very straight. Nia steps into the clearing with the lit lantern, and all three stare at the flame.

captions.line: Stay back! The bank is undercut. Lumi, stay behind me.
You are the keeper girl. Your lantern is real. I can see it from here.

continuity.cause: Follows s09: the road ends at the station, where the two chart-marks become Tam, Lumi, and a boat with nowhere to float.
continuity.entry: Nia arriving with the guarded flame; Tam guarding Lumi with an oar; strangers; flame guarded.
continuity.exit: Three met around one flame; Tam wary, Lumi trusting, Nia responsible; flame guarded.

music.mood: low ostinato weight under a wary first meeting

shots.title: The station children

shots.board: Tested and trusted, inverted: Lumi quizzes Nia on the cliff path while Tam paces. The little girl corrects Nia's count of the rope coils, twice, and Tam's glare softens into the first almost-smile of the crossing.

captions.line: You are counting our weight. Do not. Count the rope instead.
Then we climb the way you steer: slow, and talking the whole way.
Slow. I can do slow.

continuity.cause: Follows s10: strangers must become a party, so Lumi tests Nia's steadiness and Nia answers in the children's own language: boats.
continuity.entry: Three strangers around the flame; Tam distrustful; flame guarded.
continuity.exit: A party of three with a plan: Nia leads, Tam steadies, Lumi watches; flame guarded.

music.mood: ostinato softens, nia theme enters low and young

shots.title: Count the rope

shots.board: The rope traverse over white water: Nia mid-rope with the lantern hung at her chest, Tam belaying, Lumi calling the count, and below on the far bank old Ruel the mossback hauling the spare rope with his teeth. Midway the rockfall hits, the rope jerks, and Lumi's small hands catch Nia's wrist first.

captions.line: Four feet, three children, one rope. Somebody miscounted.
Hold! Hold the light up, Nia. Lumi, pull!
Got you. Got you, keeper.

continuity.cause: Follows s11: the new party attempts the broken crossing together, and the debt inverts when the children save Nia first.
continuity.entry: Party rigged on the traverse rope; Ruel hauling the spare line; flame guarded.
continuity.exit: All three across; Nia saved by Lumi's catch; the debt now runs both ways; flame guarded.

music.mood: full orchestra surge, brass over strings, rope and water

shots.title: Across the gorge

shots.board: Storm slope in driving sleet. Tam half-carries Lumi, whose bound ankle has gone hot with fever; her head lolls against his shoulder. Nia shields the lantern with her own cloak, and the flame leans hard away from the child.

captions.line: She is burning up. The cold got inside her, Nia.
Higher ground first. The cairn shelter. Just till the lee.

continuity.cause: Follows s12: the crossing survived, but the gorge's price surfaces on the slope as Lumi's fever.
continuity.entry: Party across but exposed; Lumi feverish; flame guarded but leaning; flame guarded.
continuity.exit: Fever worsening; shelter still above; one flame, two needs, no answer yet; flame guarded.

music.mood: wind motif screaming, percussion of ice on the slope

shots.title: The fever

shots.board: Close-up dialogue peak in the lee of a boulder: Nia opens the keeper's lantern and feeds half its flame into Lumi's shivering hands, cupped like a bird. The cairn flame gutters to a stub. Snow spirals down between their faces.

captions.line: Do not spend it. I am just sleepy. That is all.
Sleep, then. I will keep the warm. That is what it is for.

continuity.cause: Follows s13: the fever leaves no third way, so Nia pays the real price and spends half the keeper flame to warm Lumi.
continuity.entry: Lumi feverish in the lee; keeper flame whole; flame guarded.
continuity.exit: Lumi warming around half the flame; Nia climbing on with a guttering stub; Tam witness; flame half.

music.mood: near silence, single violin thread for a halved flame

shots.title: The choice

shots.board: The wind changes its mind. Snow that drove into their faces all night now spirals up the slope ahead of them, marking the buried steps. Nia stares, Tam laughs once in disbelief, and they climb inside the wind's hand.

captions.line: And then the wind changed its mind. All night it had pushed her back. Now it pushed her home.
It is lifting us. The wind is lifting us.

continuity.cause: Follows s14: the price paid on the slope turns the adversary, and the wind marks the buried steps for the first time.
continuity.entry: Party climbing with a halved flame; wind adversarial until now; flame half.
continuity.exit: Wind guiding; steps found; the stub still alive, still not enough; flame half.

music.mood: wind motif in major, strings blooming up the steps

shots.title: The wind changes its mind

shots.board: The last steps to the cairn: Tam carrying Lumi, Nia ahead with the stub cupped in both hands, all three bent double. The old brazier rim appears through the murk, black and cold, far too big for the little flame.

captions.line: One more traverse. Count with me, Lumi. One.
One. Two. Your hands are shaking, keeper.

continuity.cause: Follows s15: guided but not carried, the party spends the last of its strength reaching the cold brazier.
continuity.entry: Party near the cairn with a halved flame; brazier cold; flame half.
continuity.exit: At the brazier with a guttering stub; everything spent except the valley's answer; flame stub.

music.mood: cairn hymn gathering, choir-like strings on empty hands

shots.title: The last steps

shots.board: The cairn-top at the edge of night: Nia tips the stub into the great brazier and it nearly dies. Then below, one by one, the valley's kept sparks rise: the shepherd's window, the station lamp, door after door. The cairn takes every one and blooms.

captions.line: It is going out. It is not enough.
Look. Look down the valley. Everybody kept a spark.

continuity.cause: Follows s16: the stub alone fails as feared, and the sparks Nia and the valley kept station by station answer together.
continuity.entry: Stub at a cold brazier; valley dark below; flame stub.
continuity.exit: Cairn lit from many flames, Nia's least among them; night ending; flame cairn-lit.

music.mood: full orchestral arrival, cairn hymn blazing from many flames

shots.title: Many flames

shots.board: Dawn wave over Ember Hollow: window after window rekindling down the hill road in a slow bloom of gold. No figures, only light answering light, the beat coming back.

captions.line: Down in the Hollow, the beat came back. Door by door, window by window, the valley remembered its light.

continuity.cause: Follows s17: the lit cairn answers down the hill road in the rekindling wave the finale promised.
continuity.entry: Cairn lit above a dark valley; flame cairn-lit.
continuity.exit: Valley rekindled door by door; many flames where one failed; flame many.

music.mood: all motifs united, bells over orchestra, light answering light

shots.title: The valley remembers

shots.board: The keeper comes home at dawn: Yara waiting in the open door with the knotted cord, Tam steady beside the litter where Lumi sits up, awake. Yara holds out the keeper's knot without a word, and Lumi ties the final ribbon.

captions.line: Come back a keeper, she had said. And down the bright path, three keepers came.
Tight enough to hold. Loose enough to fly.

continuity.cause: Follows s18: the rekindled valley brings its keepers home, and Yara's withheld trust from Act 1 is repaid without words.
continuity.entry: Party returning with many flames behind them; Yara waiting with the knot; flame many.
continuity.exit: Knot handed over; Lumi ties the final ribbon; Nia a keeper; flame many.

music.mood: nia theme lullaby, solo woodwind farewell for three keepers

shots.title: The keeper's knot

shots.board: Coda on the hilltop at sunrise: Nia tending the hill-road lantern, flame high and steady, ribbons streaming true for once. Below, Tam mends the ferry-boat and Lumi charts the spring winds in charcoal. End title.

captions.line: Ember Hollow keeps its light the way a heart keeps its beat. And the keeper keeps the Hollow.
Tomorrow we chart the spring winds. Tonight, we keep.

continuity.cause: Follows s19: the earned ending restates the opening image with the fault repaired: lantern tended, ribbons true, keeper steady.
continuity.entry: Hill lantern relit and many flames abroad; Nia proven; flame many.
continuity.exit: Hill road kept; spring charts begun; the beat kept; flame many.

music.mood: final hymn cadence, warm silence tail over a kept road

shots.title: Hearthlight
